CREEP Fest (Apr 24-26 2026) is tagged as presenter.

venues.name: Black Squirrel Club

notes: Northern-half Philadelphia census, window 2025-01-01 to 2026-12-31. Johnny Brenda's and Kung Fu Necktie were skipped as already complete. Rows that duplicate the earlier Black Squirrel / MilkBoy crawls were removed. Much of the history comes from Songkick gigography pages (source_type aggregator), read through a summarising fetch; it misses some shows, and a few support acts may be garbled. Wayback captures (MilkBoy, PhilaMOCA, Black Squirrel) were rate-limited, so some months are thin. Filtering: DJs, producers, rappers, dance/emo/tribute theme nights, comedy, film, open mics and jams were dropped. Likely solo singer-songwriters were dropped by a first-name rule plus a manual list, so a few solo acts may remain and a few bands named like people may have been lost. Foundry rows are locals only: kept when the act appears at another Philadelphia venue in the census data. Out of area or skipped: Fergie's Pub (Center City) and The Pharmacy (Point Breeze, South Philly) are outside the area; Iron Abbey is in Horsham (Montgomery County). The Fillmore main room, Union Transfer and Brooklyn Bowl book national tours and were not crawled. Ortlieb's site and the Fallser Club calendar are JavaScript widgets (Eventbrite/DICE, Humanitix) with no archived listings. Not reached: Bandsintown and Northeast Times (403), Heart of Jazz (Cloudflare), Instagram and Facebook. Leads with no band evidence: Interstate Drafthouse, Garage Fishtown, Bottle Bar East, Martha, Atlantis, Philadelphia Brewing Co., Big Blue Marble. Other Northeast bars (Grey Lodge, Hop Angel Brauhaus, Brick House in Torresdale) had no findable lineups and are not listed. MilkBoy is in Center City but was crawled because it was a lead.
